title: NCAA: Mapua zooms to sixth straight win, breezes past San Sebastian
summary: Mapua University zoomed to its sixth straight victory after breezing past San Sebastian College, 71-43, in NCAA Season 102 men's basketball on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
